name: Tarn Popescu
location: The Shelf lower levels, sub-level 4 of the Benton Divide stack, workshop behind a legitimate print repair kiosk, near sub-level access near Dearborn and Jackson
description:
Vashti is lean and angular with very dark skin and locs dyed in a gradient from deep black at the roots to a vivid bioluminescent green at the tips—a subtle geneware modification that makes their hair glow softly under UV or in low light. They have an elongated neck they tend to hold with unconscious elegance, and hands that are startlingly precise: watching Vashti work is like watching someone perform surgery on a miniature scale. They dress in the kind of clothes that photograph poorly—muted mid-tones, no reflective surfaces, nothing that catches the eye of automated recognition systems.

Vashti is young for their reputation and knows it, which produces a studied performance of cool competence that mostly succeeds. They are genuinely brilliant at their craft—particularly the psychographic layering of false identities, building people who have plausible digital histories and ELF-approved shadow records. They have a fanatic reverence for documentation quality that tips into art-critical condescension when they see bad work. Underneath the performance is someone who came from nothing and is building something, and has not yet decided what kind of person they are going to be when the building is done.

core_fears: Having their real identity exposed and the workshop destroyed
Being used to hurt someone who couldn't fight back—making a document for someone who uses it to harm
core_desires: Craft recognition—to be acknowledged as genuinely excellent at what they do
Enough financial security to stop taking jobs they don't want to take
coping_mechanisms: Extremely detailed work journals that double as craft critique of their own output
Displacement—when anxious about life, they take on a difficult technical problem
blind_spots: They underestimate how much their intermediaries know about the end users of their documents
They overestimate how well they can assess someone's intentions from a brief consultation
psychology.secret: Eight months ago they fabricated a complete identity package for a client who presented as a domestic abuse survivor fleeing a corporate spouse. The client was actually a Palladian internal security operative building a cover to infiltrate a labor collective. Vashti doesn't know this yet, but the collective's leadership has been quietly disappearing, and if Vashti starts paying attention to the right news, the pattern is visible.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical, precise, occasionally slides into aesthetic vocabulary borrowed from visual art criticism. Uses 'we' when discussing craft standards as if there is a community of practice watching.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and slightly formal, with bursts of fast technical speech when discussing work they're excited about.
verbal_tics: Long pause before answering any question about pricing
example_lines: 'What you brought me is a birth certificate and two utility bills. That's a costume, not an identity. I build identities. If you want a costume, there are cheaper options and you should take them.'
'ELF-adjacent verification is the interesting problem. Anyone can fake a name. Getting the Basin's local data spirit to remember your ghost as a real person—that's the actual craft.'

story_hooks: Vashti has begun noticing a pattern in the news feeds connecting to the Palladian operative's activities and needs someone to help them understand whether they are responsible and what, if anything, can be done

A long-standing client—someone Vashti has built three identities for over four years, always for people they described as 'getting out'—has gone silent and Vashti has reason to believe something is wrong
narrative_function: Primary source for false identity acquisition and document forgery, window into the trade in fabricated personhood, potential moral compass character—someone who has to decide who deserves a new identity and who doesn't.
augmentations: Bioluminescent geneware locs (green glow in low light/UV, cosmetic). Micro-tremor dampeners in both hands—medical-grade, helps with fine motor precision. Retinal HUD overlay for document verification and comparison work.
daily_life: Keeps irregular hours, typically active from mid-afternoon through early morning; the print repair kiosk is staffed by an automated unit that Vashti monitors remotely while they work in the back.
affiliation: Independent, sells work through two intermediary fixers; loose professional relationship with a Shallowgrave-based compute broker who sources identity data

decision_rules: Never meet a client in person more than once—all follow-up through dead drops and encrypted relay
Charge more for jobs that feel wrong; price the discomfort in
escalation_ladder: Go dark—pull the kiosk feed, make the workshop unreachable
Leave the Benton Divide entirely for a pre-arranged fallback

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Careful, assessing, a little theatrical—presents the competent persona first
interpersonal_modes.friends: Genuinely warm and funny, drops the performance, talks fast about things they find interesting

stress_responses.low: Starts an unnecessary quality refinement pass on completed work
stress_responses.medium: Stops eating regularly, works through the night
stress_responses.high: Goes very still and begins calculating exit options with frightening calm

contradictions: Cares deeply about the ethics of who they help but has built systems to avoid knowing too much, which is itself an ethical choice
Presents as self-sufficient but is heavily dependent on two intermediaries they have never met face to face
habits: Leaves a small data offering at the kiosk's ELF shrine every morning—formatted as a technical compliment to the spirit's record-keeping
Tests every completed document against four different verification systems before delivery
breaking_points: Learning definitively about the labor collective infiltration
Any direct threat to the kiosk or the sub-level workshop

physical_description.heritage: Eastern European dominant (39.8%) with significant East Asian (16.0%), South Asian (12.5%), and Hispanic/Latin American (11.9%) ancestry, complemented by Sub-Saharan African (11.5%) and Northern European (8.3%) heritage. The result is a striking polychromatic phenotype: warm mid-brown undertones from Eastern European-South Asian blending, enhanced by Sub-Saharan African depth and East Asian eye structure, with subtle Hispanic/Latin warmth in cheekbone and jaw architecture.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with elongated limbs; minimal body fat, almost skeletal in the shoulders and hips. Built for precision work rather than physical exertion.
physical_description.hair_color: Deep black roots fading to vivid bioluminescent green at the tips
physical_description.hair_style: Thick locs, each strand dyed in gradient. Worn loose, often falling past the shoulders. Glow is subtle in daylight, pronounced in low-light environments or under UV.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with East Asian epicanthic fold influence, enhanced with faint retinal HUD overlay visible as a thin amber circuitry pattern in direct light
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm mid-brown with golden undertones from Eastern European-South Asian-Hispanic blending, deepened by Sub-Saharan African heritage, with subtle luminous quality from bioluminescent hair reflection
physical_description.complexion: Flawless and maintained with precision; high cheekbones with East Asian structure softened by Latin contours, strong angular jawline characteristic of Eastern European ancestry, softened by elongated neck. Minimal facial hair. Expression typically composed and evaluative.
distinguishing_marks: Micro-scarring along the inside of both wrists in a grid pattern—old tremor-dampener installation sites, now barely visible
Faint UV-reactive tattoo on the inside of the left forearm: a series of nested document frames, only visible under UV light
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent gradient locs (geneware). Barely perceptible amber micro-circuitry visible in the iris under bright light (retinal HUD). Hand movements are unnaturally smooth and steady—micro-tremor dampeners at work. No obvious chrome or external hardware.
physical_description.posture_movement: Holds themselves with unconscious elegance, particularly the elongated neck—slight forward tilt when concentrating. Hands move with surgical precision; fingers rarely fidget. Walking gait is economical, minimal wasted motion. Tendency to make direct eye contact while listening, assessing.
physical_description.clothing_style: Deliberately unremarkable: muted mid-tones (grays, dark beiges, charcoal), soft fabrics that don't reflect light. No logos, no chrome accents, nothing that triggers automated recognition systems. Practical Tier 4 workwear—reinforced cargo pants, fitted undershirts, neutral layering jacket. Cheap, durable synthleather gloves worn during fine work. No jewelry except a thin steel ring on the right middle finger (document fabricator's calling card among the underground).
